reviews.review_description: Very good game, lots of content. Would you consider 1) - making the grip for the direction of the vehicle with a toggle option so one doesn't have continuously grip the stick. This is challenging if one have arthritis, which I do and/or an option to have the acceleration and/or the direction mapped to the sticks. Thank you for your consideration of this.

developer_response.body: Hello! We’ll definitely add these options in an upcoming update! Thank you so much for your feedback! 🙌

reviews.review_description:
I’ve been waiting for this game for so long! After a few delays, I’m really glad it’s finally out. There’s still room for improvement, but my first impressions are awesome! It’s easy to pick up, a lot of fun, and there’s plenty of content to enjoy.
Keep up the great work! 🚀

This is the first game that I've actually anticipated. I'm not disappointed... but, it sucked having the release date change a couple times. Regardless, the game is fkn awesome! 

To anyone familiar with the original Omega Pilot, this isn't that. The controls are similar, but you steer with HOTAS, positioned center-cockpit, were you roll left and right.. as opposed to Omega Pilot, where you have a handheld controller, which can by used to control pitch, tilt and yaw. 

Every single XOCUS gave that I've played has been fire!

There is a little lag sometimes, but its nothing crazy. There's a learning curve, but once you get the hang of it, you're heart will be pounding!

If you like fast VR racing, this is definitely worth checking out. The visuals look great on Quest and the races feel intense without being overly complicated. Easy to start, but there’s plenty of room to improve your skills. 

My only complaint is that I wish there was an option to control the ship with the thumbstick.

So far loving the aesthetic and the whole vibe, when you get the steering right it's really satisfying.

Few gripes though, the weapons are awful and the weapon races don't flow, you have no clue what hit you and because there's a weapon box every 2 metres it's like your always stopping and exploding for no reason. Would rather just get slowed and know why. 

Lastly some of the tracks especially neon track  have really bad pop in of textures and you get to the road before it appears, as well as background scenery. 

Also if you turn ghost players off they disappear but you still see the explosions??? Could we just have an option where the other ghost players are transparent, as they block your view when all climoed together. 

Having multiple ships to unlock would be a nice touch with different cockpits.

Last thing is the multiplayer lobby, the matchmaking lobby just seems like a  baron space. 
Would like something where you could see other players. 

The games good but not sure about longevity. There's potential but just feels a little unfinished for some reason and I can't put my finger on it.

developer_response.body:
Thank you so much for your detailed feedback! We really appreciate it. We’ll be working on improving these issues in the upcoming update!

As for multiplayer, we’re doing everything we can to bring more players into the game! Omega Pilot Evolution supports cross-platform multiplayer in both VR and flat-screen modes, so you can invite friends to play together, no matter which device they use!

Thanks again for your support and for helping us make the game better! 🚀

reviews.review_description:
Very sad to say this is a much watered down version of the original ... Not using pitch & yaw to control the ship only steering is hugely disappointing ..no ability to control your seat up & down forward & backward ..very short tracks with no imagination ..very dull & Q2 style graphics ..no gloss & a clunky UI 
Sorry I expected much better it feels made for flat screen gaming not VR

**Hi guys thanks for the reply .. I am not saying it's a bad game at all but when U compare it the OG .. no full control of your vehicle ..no flying upside down ..incredibly short & flat courses  (the og had some minutes long to complete a lap) no gravity defying flying through open mouths & twisting tunnels into hugeee caverns etc etc .. it's a huge huge downgrade compared to the original & still imo made for flat screen not vr 

Thanks again I will continue to play & support it regardless 

Good luck 

Carl

developer_response.body:
Hello! Thank you for sharing your feedback!
You can adjust your seat position in the settings menu.
The tracks in Career mode get longer as you progress through the game. You can also try Series mode, where races are longer from the start, or create your own race with as many laps as you like!
We redesigned the controls to make racing more intuitive and comfortable for players of all skill levels. This also allows you to enjoy cross-platform multiplayer with friends on different devices, whether they play in VR or on a flat screen. However, Omega Pilot Evolution was developed with VR as our main focus.
We put a lot of effort into our games and always listen to player feedback. Our goal is to make racing enjoyable for everyone who wants to experience it.
We hope you’ll give Evolution another chance! Try upgrading and tuning your ship as you progress. You might discover a whole new level of speed and excitement! 🚀🏁

reviews.review_description: I love the original omega pilot but this is much simpler because you're on the ground. The way you roll as you take the turns is really immersive and different to all the other hover craft racing types - you need to remember to brake though because you go fast and the barriers will damage you and blow you up!

Omega Pilot Evolution is visually impressive, with beautiful futuristic tracks, a great cockpit and plenty of customization options. The controls feel precise and responsive, and the different racing, challenge, combat and multiplayer modes offer plenty to explore. I personally remain quite sensitive to motion sickness in very fast VR racing games, but thankfully several comfort options are available. Technically, this is a very polished and ambitious VR racer!

I had a blast playing this. There are tons of different tracks and a nice variety of game modes to keep things fresh. The graphics look great, and being able to customize your ride is an awesome bonus. Highly recommend!

The original took a bit of getting used to but was a masterpiece. This is a toy in comparison.

Updated from 1 star to 3 as getting used to it and it's ok but such a comdown from the original - unfortunately seems people were not up for learning how to race with six degrees of movement so the devopers had to cut it down to 4 - and add some shooting!

Response to the developer. The original has 33 tracks, two forms of Multiplayer, Speedcup, and Endurance - AND SIX DEGREES OF MOVEMENT.  My review wasn't suposed to be be funny, this is not an evolution but as someone else mentioned a devolution.

developer_response.body:
This is not funny! What are you talking about?
More than 80% of players struggled with the controls in the original game. Just read the reviews if you don’t believe us. We put a huge amount of work into Evolution specifically to avoid repeating those mistakes and to make the controls enjoyable and accessible. Now anyone can play comfortably, regardless of their experience level. We completely rebuilt the physics and controls to make them work better for everyone.
Evolution also has much more content: 11 biomes, 28 tracks, Career mode, Series mode, races with bots, weapon racing, Combat Arena, and fully cross platform multiplayer across VR and flat screen devices, so friends can easily play together. We also significantly improved the graphics and added many more visual effects to make the racing experience more immersive and exciting.
This represents an enormous amount of work from our team, all focused on giving players a better experience. And instead of recognizing any of that effort, you gave the game the lowest possible rating, 1 star.
We strongly disagree that the game deserves such a low rating. Unfortunately, developers are almost defenseless against this kind of damage to a game’s rating. A single 1 star review can seriously hurt a game and undermine the enormous amount of work put in by a small team.
We kindly ask you to reconsider your rating and give the game a rating that fairly reflects more than a year of hard work our team has put into creating Evolution.

reviews.review_description: Damm...
Fun game fast and unforgiving. Love it

reviews.review_title: Could have been great but its ok
reviews.review_description: I cant 5 star this one. This could have been q3s wipeout, the vehicles are good, drive nice, and control is a challenge enough, but the tracks wt actual f were you thinking? The tracks are the most boring mario cart 64 garbage. They are all flat as a pancake, where is the vertical mix? Where are the big loops? Why are the tracks so short? Come on man, I would rather you took it back to the drawing board than released this monkey spooge.

reviews.review_title: Worthy successor to the original game
reviews.review_description:
Well done to Xocus you have managed to exceed the original while making it much more accessible to a new player who hasn’t played original game, still as challenging but still easy to pick up early on. 

Having the virtual joystick move when you move your hand is much welcomed as I was never sure in the original game if my hand was in the optimal position.

If you are looking for a good racing game that is affordable you should really check this out as I think it is perfectly priced for the game it is.

The combat racing is probably my favorite part. Dodging opponents while using weapons and trying to stay on the racing line makes every race feel chaotic in a good way. The Arena mode is definitely my favorite — it’s a lot of fun and keeps the action intense.

reviews.review_title: Takes a minute to click, but pure fun af
reviews.review_description: The controls took a little getting used to at first, but once I got the hang of it, I was hooked. Chasing track records and setting new best times feels super rewarding. Plus, the Arena mode is an absolute blast!
Really fun futuristic racing game. The sense of speed in VR is awesome, and the controls feel surprisingly precise. Once you get used to the handling, flying through the tracks is super satisfying.

Omega Pilot Evolution delivers pure, unadulterated joy—every session feels like a celebration of arcade thrills and immersive simulation. The studio’s pedigree shines through, with standout titles like OMEGA Pilot and EXOcars (a personal favorite in VR racing) proving their knack for polished, addictive gameplay.
Progressive mastery is at the heart of the experience. Unlock new levels upon completion, regardless of your final position, while earning currency to upgrade your anti-gravity ship through replaying earlier stages. The depth doesn’t stop there—dive into Career Mode, Series Mode, Combat Racing, Arena Battles, and Cross-Platform Multiplayer for endless replayability.
Crisp visuals, razor-sharp handling, and a perfectly tuned balance between acceleration and maneuverability make every race feel responsive and exhilarating. Whether you’re chasing high scores or just savoring the rush of zero-gravity drift, this is VR racing at its finest.

I loved the steering of the original. I wish there was an option to choose between the two. I know people complained about the steering learning curve of the original but it made racing feel so much more immersive and real. I wish the graphics were smoother. I wish my ship wouldn't stick to the wall like a magnet whenever I run into walls. After I crash and explode, I wish the stick would stay in my hand if I'm still holding the grip button. I wish more people knew about this game. I wish more advanced shuttles were unlockable with various attributes and advantages. I feel Evolution has been simplified to a kind of hoverbike racer. Being able to fly up and over your opponent, or do a barrel roll is an amazing feeling. I want that feeling again!
This game is a sequel to the pioneer of the tired-old car racing genre. Here, you can ram opponents off the track and get a huge rush of excitement!

Hand let's go of singular control stick in game repeatedly. All other games i play dont do this.

I wish there were more interaction surfaces in the cockpit, there isnt even a throttle or anything for your left hand, but left trigger is the brakes.

The wobbly nature of this control scheme is what players have to defeat 1st. After that its realizing the vehicle can go much faster than it should on the turns.

Slow is smooth, smooth is fast.

Not much here, nobody in multiplayer, but the music is alright and the tunnel vision flying is not horrible. 3 stars. I have 2 other games on standalone Quest3 that do all of this better, the best of wich is Downtown Club.

developer_response.body:
Hello! Thank you for your feedback!
Please check the tracking of your VR controller. The issue with your hand losing grip on the control stick might be caused by poor lighting in your room.
We’d be happy to help you get more comfortable with the game and discover everything it has to offer!
There are several game modes to explore:
- Career Mode: Race against real players’ ghost recordings.
- Series Mode: Race against AI opponents that become more challenging as you progress.
- Combat Racing: Race with weapons and shields.
- Arena Mode: Battle other players using weapons.
You can also customize, upgrade, and fine-tune your ship to match your racing style!
Regarding multiplayer, keeping VR lobbies full can be challenging. That’s why we made the game fully cross-platform! You can race with friends on other VR or flat-screen platforms.
We’re a small team, and we’re always happy to hear your suggestions and help you enjoy the game!

reviews.review_description: Super fun racing game! The graphics look great, and you really feel the speed. Had a total blast playing it

Omega Pilot Evolution gives me the futuristic racing vibe I’ve been looking for in VR. Fast ships, cool tracks, upgrades and leaderboards all work really well together. I can easily see myself spending a lot of time improving my runs.
